text:
jen: CI is red on the hosted integration suite. Failing tests look like auth + streaming + tool-calling mix, shard 12 failing repeatedly. Anyone oncall?
ci-bot: build 8421 failed — integrations/hosted/* — https://ci.internal.redwood/8421 (logs attached)
samir: jumping in, rerunning shard 12 now — will post results in a minute.
samir: rerun complete — shard 12 still failing, same tests: test_stream_tool_with_auth and test_stream_schema_validation. Paste from failing assertion below.
jen: can you paste the failing trace and the request/response payload?
samir: stack (trimmed):
```
AssertionError: expected status 401 but got 200
File "tests/integration/test_tooling.py", line 128, in test_stream_tool_with_auth
    assert resp.status_code == 401
Response body:
{"error":{"type":"invalid_schema","message":"missing 'tools' field"}}
Request:
POST /v1/chat/stream
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>, Content-Type: application/json
Payload: {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"call tool"}], "stream": true}
```
maria: interesting — token accepted (200) but response says invalid_schema. That suggests the auth proxy accepted the request but something in the streaming path rewrote the body/headers. @rui any recent ingress/proxy changes?
rui: I pushed a small nginx change yesterday to tweak chunked transfer handling (commit abc123). I did not expect header rewrites but will check.
maria: quick repro request we want someone to run: `curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}],"stream":true}' https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream` — paste response headers and body.
samir: ran the curl against hosted (using same token as CI harness) — output gist: https://internal-gists/stream-curl-1719 (private). TL;DR: upstream accepted, but chunked bodies arrive with missing 'tools' field in parsed JSON on runtime side. Also see Content-Type gets cleared on some chunks.
jen: that matches the test failures. If headers are being dropped mid-stream that would break schema validation on the model runner.
rui: I'm rolling back the nginx chunked patch now on ingress/proxy and will trigger a staged deploy to hosted region-1. Will post status.
ops-bot: rollback job started for service=ingress/proxy by=rui, job id=rb-2201 — watch: https://deploys.internal/rollbacks/rb-2201
samir: while rollback is in flight, can we try a local/regression repro against staging to confirm? Command I used to reproduce locally: `pytest tests/integration/test_tooling.py::test_stream_tool_with_auth -q -k stream --hosted-url https://staging-hosted.redwood.ai --token $TEST_TOKEN`
maria: good plan — if staging passes after rollback, we can bisect the commit that introduced the change. If staging still fails, it's likely something else (client-side change or CI harness).
jen: assigning bisect to @samir — if you get a local repro, run `git bisect` between deploy tags v2026.03.15..v2026.03.18 to find offending nginx commit. If rollback fixes infra quickly, we can unflake tests.
ci-bot: scheduled rerun of integrations (shard 12) in 2 minutes — job 8423.
rui: rollback deployed to region-1, logs show fewer header modifications. Monitoring for errors.
ci-bot: job 8423 started.
samir: job 8423 passed on shard 12 — looks green for the two failing tests. Repo logs show request Content-Type preserved during streaming.
jen: nice :thumbsup: — thanks all. Next steps: open postmortem note, mark the nginx patch as rollout-blocker for streaming endpoints, and add a quick integ smoke in the deploy pipeline for ingress changes. I'll file follow-ups.
maria: I'll update the flaky-tests list and unmark the tests after we verify a few more runs.
jen: closing loop — if anyone sees recurrence ping this thread.
